evaluator_alignment.source_statement: The submission uses the three specified 300 K experimental P21/c crystals and preserves their individual Cl, Br, and I identities through calculation and reporting.
Every reported gap and band-edge assignment is supported by validation evidence for that same named crystal.
Source scalar-relativistic HSE06 Pb-framework-related interband energies are approximately Cl 4.63, Br 4.64, I 4.44 eV; these are not the fundamental gaps to the lowest unoccupied organic states.
The computed cross-crystal trend is interpreted using a clearly defined structural descriptor and independently considered alternatives, without requiring the authors' interpretation.
The source supports a lower I endpoint for the Pb-framework-related scalar-relativistic electronic interband gap, not necessarily for the fundamental gap or a proven optical onset.
Reduced-model SOC estimates are not equivalent to a validated direct parent-cell SOC calculation, and structural correlations alone do not prove causality.
The submission uses the three specified 300 K experimental P21/c crystals and preserves their individual Cl, Br, and I object identities through calculation and reporting.
The reported gaps are supported by per-object numerical-stability evidence and band/DOS or equivalent band-edge evidence.
Source scalar-relativistic HSE06 Pb-framework-related interband energies are approximately Cl 4.63, Br 4.64, I 4.44 eV; these are not the fundamental gaps to the lowest unoccupied organic states.
The source framework-related scalar-relativistic interband trend has I below Cl/Br; the fundamental-gap trend is a different observation.
The source supports a lower I endpoint for the Pb-framework-related scalar-relativistic electronic interband gap, not necessarily for the fundamental gap or a proven optical onset.
Any SOC estimate based on reduced model cells is an approximate trend correction and must be distinguished from a direct parent-cell SOC calculation.

No SOC substitution. Paper labels these room-temperature cells 300K; CIF measurement metadata is 296K.

method.summary: Existing converged parent HSE06 SCF and independent projection evidence on two meshes
method.settings: VASP 6.3.2 (author 6.3.0 disclosed); fixed supplied parent cells, PAW/HSE06, AEXX=.25, HFSCREEN=.2/A, default ENCUT=400eV, EDIFF=1e-7eV, ISPIN=2, LSORBIT=F, NSW=0, LORBIT=11. No SOC substitution. Paper labels these room-temperature cells 300K; CIF measurement metadata is 296K.

validation.coverage: Three parent objects; both independent projection meshes; every saved eigenvalue and unoccupied candidate. No full-Brillouin-zone extremum proof.

structural_comparison.descriptor: Norm of supplied crystallographic a vector: Cl=9.2210, Br=9.3638, I=9.6254 angstrom.
structural_comparison.sign_convention: Positive elongation from Cl through Br to I; framework edge I lower on both meshes, fundamental I higher.
structural_comparison.evidence: The I framework state has stronger organic mixing than Cl/Br (Pb-p weights and component maps in verification_supplement.json). Thus a-axis correlation is not isolated causation. Cl/Br fine ordering reverses across meshes.

author_route_results.conclusion: Current scalar framework comparison supports I below Cl/Br. Fundamental gaps instead increase Cl to Br to I in these samples. No robust Cl/Br fine ordering or optical allowedness is claimed.
author_route_results.limitations: Finite sampled meshes, rounded PAW-sphere projections and component similarity without wavefunction-overlap proof. Directness is sample-dependent. Optical allowedness not_established; SOC not computed here. VASP patch-version difference disclosed. Not a blind autonomous-agent replay.
